mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_outbox_message (tenant_id, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, event_type, payload, status) VALUES (#{m.tenantId}, #{m.aggregateType}, #{m.aggregateId}, #{m.eventType}, #{m.payload}::jsonb, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, aggregate_type AS aggregateType, aggregate_id AS aggregateId, event_type AS eventType, payload::text AS payload, status, retry_count AS retryCount, next_retry_at AS nextRetryAt, last_error AS lastError FROM erp_outbox_message WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= now()) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_outbox_message SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{error}, status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetry} THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'PENDING' END, next_retry_at = now() + ((retry_count + 1) * #{backoffSeconds} || ' seconds')::interval WHERE id = #{id}
